name: ai-dj
description: AI DJ — autonomous professional DJ powered by AI

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-dj/shared && npm run build -w @ai-dj/server && npm run build -w @ai-dj/client
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @ai-dj/server & npm run dev -w @ai-dj/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ai-dj/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ai-dj/server && npm run typecheck -w @ai-dj/client
